data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, **I'd recommend Stripe for most businesses**, with Shopify Payments as the better choice if you're building your store on Shopify.

The best option depends on three things: transaction fees, ease of integration, and how much you want to manage payments yourself.

Assuming you're operating in the UK, here's how I'd compare the main options.

## Best payment processors compared

![CardPaymentOptions.com – Merchant account and credit card processing reviews, ratings, and comparisons. Find the best merchant services provider for your business here.](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZyZx-kGJMZw-frY74Lp0ngbxxLn259SUwCVVGOs1w20aKyIMId6L9a8Lefu8zLlMx7xnfJ4MU7qPcSfFbO5tVAgdPB1Khq5kNSJbYx1vk3M83mq8t33NR3qOgnaDJXn_nY49IEKKDAg_eN4eUQrXqatPrzUusxUBWQPGwHzhUeEf4Nh96ZP9rKyCEo6DL8AI?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

1.5% + 20p for standard UK cards

- No monthly processing fee.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce and custom websites.
- Supports Apple Pay, Google Pay and international payments.
- Good fraud prevention and reporting.

[Stripe UK pricing](https://stripe.com/GB/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

From 2% + 25p on Basic

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- No separate payment gateway needed.
- Simple refunds and payment management.
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fee.

[Shopify UK pricing](https://www.shopify.com/uk/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![PayPal Review: Is It the Right Payment Solution for You?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Tb4l2sAZiezYqSwWI257xsR6Xu0StrpvRBfglhUmoX3ym_BKZCv57DPk0af1Bp6xi5ybj92wq6prLOQZ307hFyJz2zbjdBN1HYy64DdJYUxgA51W2YSY0pG7XDgLKYG9Y_6a9G9miy6Oqt5DjWtXQyteBeRgO2-fjh76KKoiZnmx1ygYUuHA2W6jRY5_Ji16?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

Standard commercial payments: 2.9% + fixed fee

- Recognised and trusted by many customers.
- Customers can pay using PayPal.
- Useful as an additional checkout option.
- Can be more expensive than Stripe.

[PayPal UK merchant fees](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business/paypal-business-fees?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Square, Inc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/o-iRI2kybznmyDubdZ44gVK-vjE6gDKLVakQnJxlACGxko3Nj1jIpWaBRdIuWDcPvStz6IZe1O-k-UExmpEW7lDQ_S559qV-l4JT0xhrWDjCbTjdZDVgBDFR6LW32FKPeauHAWGYSuEdhn0AMiHDAZFaPUNLlmIzwiGcOc7OZzuhVnlNs80uSa8gb9GbKVsf?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

Around 1.4% + 25p for UK online cards

- Straightforward setup.
- Good for selling online and in person.
- Useful free business tools.
- Less flexible than Stripe for complex integrations.

[Square and other UK payment options](https://wise.com/gb/blog/online-payment-systems?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Independent online store | Stripe |
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| Want customers to pay with PayPal | Add PayPal |
| Online and physical shop | Square |
| Recurring bank payments | GoCardless |


For most new independent online stores, I'd start with Stripe and offer PayPal as an additional payment method.
